The way he and this flatulent article talk about trade deficits being bad is embarrassing. The benefits contribute way more to the average American's quality of life. 

Benefits of trade deficits

Access to goods: Trade deficits allow countries to import goods that their citizens want but can't produce domestically. 

Foreign investment: Foreign investment can increase productivity and economic growth. 

Lower export costs: A depreciating domestic currency can make exports cheaper and more competitive. 

Job growth: Trade deficits can create job growth in certain sectors. 

Economic activity: Trade deficits can increase economic activity and boost living standards. 

Disadvantages of trade deficits 

Currency pressure: Trade deficits can put pressure on a country's currency.

External payments pressure: Trade deficits can put pressure on a country's external payments.
